claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black tower UPS with a front control/power panel and visible power plug/cables.

risks.risk: Battery health is unknown (runtime under load, whether battery is original or replaced).
risks.proof: A short clip showing the UPS running on battery (unplug mains) with the status/battery indicator and a load test (e.g., phone charger + small lamp) for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a UPS with unknown battery condition (worst case: battery weak/not holding charge).

risks.risk: Capacity (VA/W) and outlet count/type are unknown, affecting suitability and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating label showing VA/W and the number/type of outlets.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest/most uncertain capacity tier until the rating label is shown.

risks.risk: Functionality in mains and backup modes is unverified (may not switch correctly or may alarm).
risks.proof: A video demonstrating: (1) UPS on mains, (2) mains unplug to force battery mode, (3) mains restore back to normal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested for correct transfer/backup operation.

risks.risk: Ports/back panel condition and ventilation/circuit integrity are not shown in detail.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the back/side ports, vents, and any visible damage/corrosion or loose connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear/port issues due to lack of close-up inspection.

risks.risk: Exact model number/serial label is not readable, limiting verification and correct parts sourcing.
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the serial/model plate (front or back) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price with reduced confidence because exact model/parts compatibility can’t be confirmed.

risks.risk: Accessories are unknown (manual, cables, mounting, warranty), which affects completeness.
risks.proof: A photo list showing everything included (power cable, any USB/serial cable, manual, mounting brackets).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the UPS rating label (VA/W, input/output, outlet count/type).
Close-up photo of the model/serial plate with readable text.
Video test: UPS on mains, then unplug to run on battery, then plug back to mains (show status indicators).
Clip showing runtime under a small load (even a phone charger + lamp) and any alarms/beeps.
Close-up photos of back ports/vents and any visible wear/damage.
Photos of all accessories included (manual, cables, mounting/warranty items).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a UPS (brand text “BLUE GATE” visible), so it can be priced at its worst case. Key value drivers—battery health, capacity, and verified backup operation—are not shown, so the price should assume the least favorable condition until proof is provided.
